svg.data-power-typical-scope: AC typical power draw from the MX Series family datasheet, which names no configuration, ambient or side; DC 6670 W
svg.data-cooling-system-w: 640 W high-capacity at full speed (450 W typical at normal speed); normal-capacity 600 W (400 W typical) - Table 95
svg.data-max-thermal-output: AC 27,007 BTU/h (7920 W); DC 18,987 BTU/h (5568 W) (Table 84; provisioning ceiling)

g.data-description: the four C20 receptacles at the rear, one per PEM. A separate group from `psus` because they are separate objects - the inlet is the cord's end and stays with the chassis while a PEM comes out - and because sharing `psus` would put two things at every rel-pos 0-3.
g.title: inlet-0
